result.title: PartAgent: Agentic 3D Part Segmentation via Expert Integration and Closed-Loop Refinement
result.summary: Segmenting a 3D object into semantically meaningful parts requires joint reasoning about geometric structure and semantic context. Pretrained 3D experts provide spatially grounded region proposals, while 2D experts provide semantic cues for identifying object parts. The challenge is to integrate these complementary capabilities into a framework that can both produce meaningful part segmentations and progressively refine them. We present PartAgent, a training-free agentic framework for 3D part segmentation built upon two complementary modules: (i) Structural-Semantic Expert Integration combines regions predicted by the 3D expert with multiview semantic evidence from the 2D expert through image-to-surface correspondences, constructing compositional part partitions at multiple granularities. (ii) Observation-Driven Closed-Loop Partition Refinement observes the current partition and its supporting evidence to select targeted inspection, evidence repair, composition, or reselection actions. It verifies proposed changes and uses the updated state and action outcomes to guide subsequent decisions. On PartObjaverse-Tiny-WT, PartAgent achieves 68.41 mIoU, outperforming the strongest competing method by 8.53 points. Across 3DCoMPaT200, PartNeXt, PartNetE, and PartObjaverse-Tiny, PartAgent achieves the highest mIoU on each dataset, averaging 69.36 across the four datasets, 7.28 points above the highest mean among competing methods.

AI.brief_summary: PartAgent 提出免训练的智能体式三维部件分割框架，把三维专家的空间区域提议与二维专家的多视图语义线索经图像—表面对应融合成多粒度部件划分，再用闭环循环观察当前划分及其证据，选择检查、证据修复、重组或重选动作并验证改动。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「观察状态与证据—选择动作—验证并更新」的闭环可能为 LVR 的迭代推理状态更新、视觉证据筛选与停止决策提供启发性参照，但任务属三维分割，与 VLM 内部 latent 状态的联系仍需核查。
